# Copyright

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Copyright`](gmeow-Copyright.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Copyright>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The reified copyright over a work — binding the work, its holder(s), the copyright year and the human-readable notice. Its status (in-copyright, public-domain, …) is a [`gmeow:copyrightStatus`](../properties/gmeow-copyrightStatus.md) value aligned to RightsStatements.org / PREMIS.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Copyright`](gmeow-Copyright.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to reify the copyright over a work when its holder(s), year, notice, or RightsStatements.org/PREMIS status must be recorded as a first-class relator.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the deontic rule layer (who-may-do-what is a [`gmeow:RightsStatement`](gmeow-RightsStatement.md)) and avoid duplicating it as a parallel holder model — holder attribution reuses [`gmeow:wasAttributedTo`](../properties/gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md) via [`gmeow:copyrightHolder`](../properties/gmeow-copyrightHolder.md).

### How to use

- Mint one [`Copyright`](gmeow-Copyright.md), bind it to the work with [`gmeow:copyrightWork`](../properties/gmeow-copyrightWork.md), attribute holders with [`gmeow:copyrightHolder`](../properties/gmeow-copyrightHolder.md), carry [`gmeow:copyrightYear`](../properties/gmeow-copyrightYear.md) and [`gmeow:copyrightNotice`](../properties/gmeow-copyrightNotice.md), and set [`gmeow:copyrightStatus`](../properties/gmeow-copyrightStatus.md) to a RightsStatements.org-aligned value; link from the work with [`gmeow:hasCopyright`](../properties/gmeow-hasCopyright.md).

### Examples

- ex:reportCopyright a [`gmeow:Copyright`](gmeow-Copyright.md); [`gmeow:copyrightWork`](../properties/gmeow-copyrightWork.md) ex:report; [`gmeow:copyrightHolder`](../properties/gmeow-copyrightHolder.md) ex:blackcat; [`gmeow:copyrightYear`](../properties/gmeow-copyrightYear.md) "2026".
